items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Black Dot had him a race...or bookie joint but he used to paternize the Dunbar Hotel all the time

ctx.x: Black Dot had him a race...or bookie joint but he used to paternize the Dunbar Hotel all the time, and, uh, he and his gang used to go to the Rose Bowl every year out there and have a good time. An' they had a few more people but I don't recall their names... used to hang out together. Oh, boy, if I could remember all them people's names, I'd be good.
Back...I want to get this on the tape. You told me off the tape but I...where you first lived in Kansas City you said was on Independence and Charlotte. Is that right?
